provenance.name: anchored-v8
provenance.note: Anchoring to the published results of another machine with what the first washes on the owner's machine fixed held in place (round robin 2022/2023, Bosch SMV6ECX51E, eco programme, detergent D; docs/research/standards.md section 7.1), to be replaced by more washes on the owner's machine. Made on the water side "spotless-sim 0.5.0 water-7", sources sha256:03658efea6fc6c36791ade515888db1860eda2018a7f70301026f8d6334db49c; valid for that water side only (anchors/scripts/check.ts). Reference detergent D at 20 g. soil.egg_yolk.rateRef (and soil.milk.rateRef with it) fitted to the six in-machine egg-yolk rates; the lags read off the same bench data; liq.xProtease fitted to the cutlery and glass class means and soil.bleachRate to the crockery class mean of the record, each through the calibration tool's likelihood of a group mean score. Held at values the owner's washes fixed (owner-wash-01-egg-yolk-eco50: prog.soakDuty, soil.egg_yolk.bakeRate; owner-wash-02-stacked-plates-eco50: soil.egg_yolk.bakeRate): prog.soakDuty = 0.8, soil.egg_yolk.bakeRate = 0.000075; the three fits were made with them in place. Everything else is the registry's default. soil.bleachRate is kept by the floor rule: at its default every iec_tea item reads dirty, which caps the crockery mean at 3.12 against the published 3.68; the record bounds it from below only (off the floor from 0.0009). See docs/calibration/anchoring-v8.md.
